metadata.title: Governance Voting Tasks
metadata.description: Add governance vote submission from the Nodes view for all core nodes in one transaction

phases.name: Frontend Voting Flow
phases.description: Expose the governance voting UI and client-side submission path

tasks.title: Add Vote button to Nodes view
tasks.description: Expose governance voting from the Nodes page when core nodes are available

tasks.title: Create governance vote modal
tasks.description: Build the modal UI for governance action ID, per-node vote selection, and fee account selection

tasks.title: Add client-side validation
tasks.description: Validate bech32 governance action IDs and require a vote for every core node

tasks.title: Add store submission action
tasks.description: Send governance vote requests over the existing WebSocket messaging flow and surface the result to the UI

phases.name: Backend Vote Submission
phases.description: Handle vote request payloads and build the on-chain governance transaction

tasks.title: Create governance vote request model
tasks.description: Define the request payload used by the frontend and backend WebSocket handler

tasks.title: Add governance vote message endpoint
tasks.description: Create the backend message mapping that receives governance vote submissions

tasks.title: Generate per-node vote files
tasks.description: Use cardano-cli to generate governance vote files for each core node selection

tasks.title: Build combined governance transaction
tasks.description: Build a single transaction containing all vote files and a selected fee source

tasks.title: Sign and submit vote transaction
tasks.description: Sign the transaction with all required cold keys and payment key, then submit and return the TxID

phases.name: Verification
phases.description: Verify the end-to-end governance voting flow

tasks.title: Verify modal validation and UX
tasks.description: Check the modal interaction flow, default voting behavior, and validation messages

tasks.title: Run end-to-end governance vote testing
tasks.description: Verify the full governance voting flow returns a successful transaction ID

riskAreas: Multi-signature transaction assembly across all core nodes
Secure use of stored cold signing keys
summary.testingNotes: Verification focused on modal UX, payload validation, and successful end-to-end transaction submission.
summary.rollbackPlan: Remove the vote UI entry point and backend message handling if governance voting needs to be withdrawn.
